chapter: Georgie Auld, Hawkins and Los Angeles
title: The Swing Club with Scatman Carruthers and Benny Bailey
summary: Two months at the Swing Club, where he meets young Benny Bailey.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Then I went into a place called the Swing Club, with
Scatman Carruthers, and he had his band out there. He had Benny Bailey, and some cat named Sumner Smith played alto. Anyway, we were booked in there at same time, so it was a nice gig, you know.

Yeah, I met Benny Bailey. But he wasn't playing like he can play now. I was surprised to hear him when I went to Europe. He stretched out a little bit more. Because when I first met him, he was like a timid young fellow. But he knows more about the trumpet now than he did then.
But that's the way it went. So we went into the club, and shortly after that... I mean, I had a ball...
Yeah, this is '45, I think, either May or June, when I went into the Swing Club. And I stayed there for two months.
